pre_tokenizer_at_training: none (each stream surface is already an atomic pretoken)
purpose: Isolates the Unigram-LM-vs-BPE algorithm effect from the vocabulary-size and corpus-exposure confound in the native-NLLB comparison. Trained on this project's own corpus, matched vocabulary size, matched character inventory, matched special tokens -- only the subword algorithm differs from the local Plain-BPE condition.
reproducibility: NOT verified byte-reproducible across independent runs, unlike every other artifact in this repository. Empirically, two independent training runs on identical input (including single-threaded, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1) produced different tokenizer.json content. This is a characteristic of the third-party tokenizers-library Unigram/EM trainer, not of this project's own deterministic BPE trainers. This artifact is one frozen trained instance, fingerprinted below.
